trips.title: 2 Days / 1 Night Divine Balaji & Kalahasti Kshetra Tour
trips.subtitle: Tirumala Balaji • Sri Kalahasteeswara (Vayu Lingam) • Tiruchanur
trips.itinerary:
Day 1: Arrival & Tirumala Balaji Hill Darshan -> Akhilandam, Matrusri Tarigonda Vengamamba Annaprasadam -> Evening descent & overnight stay in Tirupati.
Day 2: Morning drive to Sri Kalahasti (38 km) for Rahu-Ketu Sarpa Dosha Nivarana Puja & Vayu Lingam darshan -> Afternoon visit to Tiruchanur Padmavathi Temple & ISKCON -> Evening drop at Tirupati Station/Airport.

trips.title: 3 Days / 2 Nights Complete Divya Kshetra Pilgrimage Circuit
trips.subtitle: Tirumala + Sri Kalahasti + Kanipakam + Sripuram Golden Temple (Vellore)
trips.itinerary:
Day 1: Tirumala Hill Temple Balaji Darshan, Theertham tour, Kalyana Venkateswara Swamy Temple (Srinivasa Mangapuram).
Day 2: Divine Sri Kalahasteeswara Rahu-Ketu Puja Kshetra, Kapila Theertham water shrine & Tiruchanur Divine Mother darshan.
Day 3: Swayambhu Varasiddhi Vinayaka Swamy (Kanipakam water shrine) -> Inter-state drive to Sripuram Golden Temple (Vellore, 1500kg gold leaf shrine) -> Return drop to Tirupati.

trips.title: 4 Days / 3 Nights South India Spiritual Heritage Grand Tour
trips.subtitle: Tirumala • Kalahasti • Kanchipuram Temple City • Mahabalipuram • Vellore
trips.itinerary:
Day 1: Tirupati arrival, Tirumala Balaji Special Darshan & Hill Shrine scenic exploration.
Day 2: Sri Kalahasti Rahu-Ketu Temple -> Afternoon drive to historic Kanchipuram (Ekambareswarar, Varadharaja Perumal & Kamakshi Amman).
Day 3: Mahabalipuram UNESCO Shore Temples & Arjuna's Penance ocean heritage -> Drive to Vellore.
Day 4: Sripuram Mahalakshmi Golden Temple darshan -> Kanipakam Ganesha water temple -> Return drop at Tirupati/Chennai.
